program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background, line = counts.most_common(2)[0][0], counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
            if row.count(line) > row.count(background)]
    cols = [c for c in range(width)
            if sum(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(height)) >
               sum(grid[r][c] == background for r in range(height))]

    marks = [(ri, ci) for ri, r in enumerate(rows) for ci, c in enumerate(cols)
             if grid[r][c] != line]
    r0 = min(ri for ri, _ in marks)
    r1 = max(ri for ri, _ in marks)
    c0 = min(ci for _, ci in marks)
    c1 = max(ci for _, ci in marks)
    rows = rows[r0:r1 + 1]
    cols = cols[c0:c1 + 1]

    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        result_row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[ra][ca], grid[ra][cb], grid[rb][ca], grid[rb][cb])
            result_row.append(corners[0] if all(v == corners[0] for v in corners) else background)
        out.append(result_row)
    return out
'''
